verdicts.rationale: REST v2 /entities/search endpoint accepts nprobe=0 in searchParams without validation. Source code analysis (handler_v2.go:generateSearchParams at utils.go:2192-2247) confirms NO validation is performed on search parameter values. Test expectations (idx_ivf_rabitq.py:209) show nprobe should be validated to range [1, 65536], but this validation is absent in REST v2 handler. Physical constraint: IVF search requires nprobe >= 1 to probe partition lists. Comparison test shows limit parameter IS validated (rejects 0), proving validation infrastructure exists but is inconsistently applied. Matches developer blindspot pattern 'REST_v2_data_type_handling'. This is a genuine Type1_IllegalSuccess defect: API accepts semantically invalid parameter and returns successful response without error.
